why_this_paper_matters: This paper demonstrates a direct link between SIRT3 and mitochondrial quality control in granulosa cells, showing how SIRT3 downregulation contributes to senescence in aged ovarian follicles through impaired mitophagy, elevated ROS, and increased mitochondrial fragmentation. This finding is critical for understanding the mechanisms of follicular development and potential interventions for age-related reproductive decline.
